title: Selected Liberating Structures adaptations
scope: 18 selected entries; 16 new articles, two extensions; no connected group features

patterns.title: Surface Higher-Level Goals
patterns.originator_or_source: Henri Lipmanowicz, Keith McCandless, and Nancy White
use_when: I want a promotion but am unsure what it would give me.
We agree on a target for very different reasons.
How can I ask about purpose without telling someone their motives?
example_user_queries: I want a promotion but am unsure what it would give me.

practice.title: Explore Purpose and Return to Options
practice.format: Individual purpose inquiry; optional partner consent
practice.outputs_are: Participant-supplied reflections or proposals; no actions, consent, votes, or conversations are generated.

visual.alt_text: A promotion branches into income, responsibility, and recognition. Each branch points to a different possible purpose: financial security, consequential work, and feeling valued.
visual.caption: Keep the branches distinct. A route that increases income may not provide responsibility or recognition; the person decides which purposes fit their experience.
visual.rationale: The tree preserves multiple legitimate purposes instead of collapsing the goal into a single inferred motive.

goals: Clarify what an immediate goal enables and compare alternative routes.
mechanisms: Make means–ends links explicit while allowing the person to correct purpose hypotheses.
prerequisites: A concrete situation or experience to examine

practice.title: Draw, Listen, and Discover

visual.alt_text: A wordless drawing places one person between two blocks. A revised drawing shows people within both blocks and several possible connections. Tentative interpretations sit outside the drawings.
visual.caption: Changing scale and relationships can open a question about connecting work. The viewer’s interpretation remains tentative, and the artist can correct or reject it.
visual.rationale: The paired drawings demonstrate the change of representation while keeping interpretations outside the wordless image.
